topic: Crocodile aimed a sandstorm at Yuba and Toto because he had learned of Luffy's friendship with him, using it to make Luffy drop his guard
title: Crocodile Aimed At Toto To Get To Luffy
description: Crocodile's sandstorm on Yuba was never about the town. The wiki shows he used Luffy's friendship with Toto to lower the rookie's guard before their fight.
comment: Was the Yuba sandstorm Crocodile's cleverest move, or his first big mistake?

lines.text: Crocodile never fought Luffy first. He went after Toto's town.

shot.fallback: scarred warlord watching a storm over a desert town

lines.text: But here is the part people skip.
Those sandstorms eating Yuba were his, part of sabotaging Alabasta's towns.
Then he learned Luffy had made friends with Toto.

shot.fallback: boy in a straw hat beside an old man

lines.text: So he targeted that exact town, and the wiki says it made Luffy drop his guard.

shot.fallback: boy stunned by a ruined town

lines.text: Think about that. He didn't scout Luffy's strength. He scouted his heart.

shot.fallback: warlord watching a boy from a dune

lines.text: People say it was just cruelty. The wiki says it was a plan.

shot.fallback: map of a desert kingdom with pins

lines.text: A man who profiles friendships that carefully wouldn't leave Vivi to chance.
So what did he want from the princess?

shot.fallback: blue haired princess in desert clothes

lines.text: Because he never fought Luffy first. He went after Toto's town.

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim: Crocodile fought a town before he fought Luffy
self_check.loop: last line restates the opening claim as a lead-in
